name: Four Photo Stop Motion
summary: Cycle four photos as a beat-synced stop motion with blur hits, a black pause and a dark fade, over bundled music, as editable Image clips.

compatibility.selects: Needs public original Image placement, effect/graphic/transform/Audio program reads, clipSourceWindow (client PR #7828), Audio overlays and asynchronous atomic file storage. Unsupported reads stop before committing. Do not publish before the prerequisite SDK rollout. Installed-app and Windows runtime, full playback and export checks remain pending.
